iq-8Q3g.title: Coverage: one trekker in a museum
iq-8Q3g.summary: All coverage is a single trekker inside a national museum in the capital.

iq-GRAo.title: Coverage: pointed trekker blur
iq-GRAo.summary: The trekker blur has a clear, pointed shape.

iq-ZqvN.title: Coverage: overexposed Gen 1.5 camera
iq-ZqvN.summary: A trekker with a camera like Gen 2 but with clearly worse quality and colour. Often overexposed, sometimes blindingly so. This quality is called Gen 1.5.

iq-gZMi.title: Houses: museum halls with statues
iq-gZMi.summary: Inside the museum you see statues, carved stone slabs, artefacts and a few back rooms.

iq-sXI8.title: Landscape: patio with date palms
iq-sXI8.summary: The only outdoor coverage is a small patio with a diagonal walkway and many date palms. It is the only part that rarely shows up in serious maps.
